materials.title: daily routines — Foundational Practice
materials.exercise_body:
**TITLE:** My Daily Routines

**INSTRUCTIONS:** 
This worksheet is designed for you to practice your Italian language skills. You will write sentences about your daily routine using the word banks and sentence starters provided. Complete all tasks in the given time.

**EXERCISE:**
Today, I wake up early because it's a sunny day. After getting dressed, I eat breakfast with my family. Then, I go to school where I learn new things. In the afternoon, I play sports at the park with friends. Before dinner, I do my homework and read a book. Finally, I watch TV or play video games until bedtime.

**SCAFFOLDING NOTES:** 
word bank, sentence starter, visual cue placeholders
materials.teacher_note: 1 student(s) assigned. Heavy-scaffolding tier. Offer a model first; allow pointing, drawing, or L1 responses.

materials.title: daily routines — On Track Practice
materials.exercise_body:
**TITLE:** Italian Daily Routines

**INSTRUCTIONS:** 
Complete this worksheet by writing your own daily routine in Italian, inspired by the example given. Use simple vocabulary and structures from what you have learned so far.

**EXERCISE:**
Write a short paragraph about your daily routine using simple sentences. Your paragraph should include at least 5 items from your day (e.g., waking up, having breakfast, going to school). Below is an example of how it can be done:
- **Example:** 
   - Sveglia me alle sette.
   - Pranzo con la famiglia al ristorante vicino a casa.
   - Vado in scuola dal mattino alla sera.

**Your Routine:**
- (Write your own routine here, using the simple vocabulary and structures you have learned.)

**SCAFFOLDING NOTES:** 
simple vocabulary, sentence structure reinforcement
materials.teacher_note: 1 student(s) assigned. Moderate-scaffolding tier. Walk through the model example together, then release to independent practice.

materials.title: Italian Daily Routines Adventure
materials.instructions_for_student: This fun exercise is all about learning new words for daily activities. You will work alone to practice these words and then share what you learned with a friend.
materials.exercise_body: Imagine you are going on an adventure through your day in Italy. Write down the things you do at home, like eating breakfast or watching TV. Use Italian vocabulary for each activity. Then, find a partner and compare what you wrote. Discuss which activities you do together and which ones are different between you.
materials.teacher_note: No students currently at this tier. Minimal-scaffolding tier. Invite transfer to new contexts; ask for evidence, not speed.
